_note: Temporary store of pending suggestions, used by the app. Path: .nyssa-ai/daily-tasks/suggestions.json (one per workspace, not per day). plan_suggest writes here; screens read pending items from here. When a suggestion is acted on (accepted, edited or rejected) it is removed from this file and recorded as a decision-log entry, which carries its question, origin and message IDs. A suggestion that is never acted on exists only here: it is shown again in later sessions, and its messages stay unreviewed in the message log. No new suggestion is proposed for a message that already has a pending one.
